::: {.about-section}

<span class="section-label">A little about me</span>

## Energy systems, analytics, and applied technology

I recently completed an M.S. in Energy Systems at Northeastern University. My background is in mechanical and energy engineering, with experience across renewable energy, energy and climate data, research, analytics, and technical software work.

My interests often sit between disciplines — energy systems and economics, data analytics, and the growing use of AI in technical and analytical work. This site gives me one place to connect those areas without forcing everything into the format of a resume or a formal publication.

:::

::: {.about-section .about-sharing}

<span class="section-label">Why I share</span>

## Useful when it is clear enough to use

I like sharing things that are practical and genuinely useful.

Sometimes an article starts with a project, a tool I had to learn, a coding problem, or an energy question. If I can turn what I learned into a clearer explanation, workflow, or example that may help someone else, I would rather share it than keep it in my own notes.

That is the main purpose of the Learning Hub.

:::
